title.zh: 卷三十六 志第二十六 五行三
title.raw: 卷三十六 志第二十六 五行三 Volume 36 Treatises 30: Five Elements 3

sentences.zh: 《五行傳》曰：「簡宗廟，不禱祠，廢祭祀，逆天時，則水不潤下。」

translations.literal: The Treatise on the Five Elements says: "If one simplifies the ancestral temples, does not pray and offer sacrifice, abandons worship, and defies the seasons, then water does not moisten downward."
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on the Five Elements states: "When rulers curtail the ancestral temples, neglect prayer and sacrifice, abandon the rites of worship, and defy the seasons, water ceases to flow downward as it should."

sentences.zh: 謂水失其性，百川逆溢，壞鄉邑，溺人民，而為災也。

translations.literal: This means that when water loses its proper nature, the hundred streams overflow contrary to their course, ruin villages and towns, drown the people, and become disaster.
translations.idiomatic: This means that when water abandons its proper character, the hundred streams reverse and overflow, destroy villages and towns, drown the people, and bring disaster.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「聽之不聰，是謂不謀。

translations.literal: It also says: "If hearing is not acute, this is called lack of deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: It further says: "When hearing fails, that is called want of deliberation.

sentences.zh: 厥咎急，厥罰常寒，厥極貧。

translations.literal: Its blame is haste, its penalty is persistent cold, its extreme is poverty.
translations.idiomatic: The fault lies in rashness, the penalty in unending cold, and the extreme in destitution.

sentences.zh: 時則有鼓妖，時則有豕禍，時則有耳痾，時則有雷電、霜、雪、雨、雹、黑眚黑祥，惟火沴水。」

translations.literal: At times there are drum omens; at times swine calamities; at times ear ailments; at times thunder, frost, snow, rain, hail, black omens and black auspices; only fire injuring water."
translations.idiomatic: Then come ominous drums; calamities involving swine; diseases of the ears; and thunder, frost, snow, rain, hail, black omens and black portents—and only fire can injure water."

sentences.zh: 水不潤下貞觀三年秋，貝、譙、鄆、泗、沂、徐、豪、蘇、隴九州水。

translations.literal: Water fails to moisten downward. In autumn of the third year of Zhenguan, the nine provinces of Bei, Qiao, Yun, Si, Yi, Xu, Hao, Su, and Long suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: When water fails to moisten downward: In the autumn of the third year of Zhenguan (629), floods struck the nine provinces of Bei, Qiao, Yun, Si, Yi, Xu, Hao, Su, and Long.

sentences.zh: 水，太陰之氣也。

translations.literal: Water is the qi of greater yin.
translations.idiomatic: Water is the breath of greater yin.

sentences.zh: 若臣道顓，女謁行，夷狄彊，小人道長，嚴刑以逞，下民不堪其憂，則陰類勝，其氣應而水至；

translations.literal: If ministerial conduct is obstinate, female favorites act, the barbarians are strong, the way of petty men grows long, harsh punishments are imposed to excess, and the lower people cannot bear their distress, then the yin categories prevail, its qi responds, and water comes;
translations.idiomatic: When ministerial conduct grows obstinate, palace women gain sway, foreign peoples grow strong, petty men prevail, harsh punishments are wielded without restraint, and the common people cannot endure their suffering, then yin forces dominate; their qi responds and water arrives;

sentences.zh: 其謫見于天，月及辰星與列星之司水者為之變，若七曜循中道之北，皆水祥也。

translations.literal: Its reprimand appears in heaven; the moon, the Chronographic Star, and the asterisms that govern water undergo change thereby; if the seven luminaries follow north of the central path, all are omens of water.
translations.idiomatic: Its rebuke appears in the heavens: the moon, Mercury, and the stars that govern water all shift accordingly; when the seven luminaries track north of the central path, these are all portents of water.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，許、戴、集三州水。

translations.literal: In autumn of the fourth year, the three prefectures of Xu, Dai, and Ji suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year of Zhenguan (630), floods struck the three prefectures of Xu, Dai, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 七年八月，山東、河南州四十，大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year, forty prefectures in Shandong and Henan suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Zhenguan (633), forty prefectures in Shandong and Henan were struck by great floods.

sentences.zh: 八年七月，山東、江淮大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year, great floods in Shandong and the Yangzi-Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year of Zhenguan (634), great floods struck Shandong and the Yangzi-Huai region.

sentences.zh: 十年，關東及淮海旁州二十八，大水。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, twenty-eight prefectures east of the Pass and along the Huai-Hai suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Zhenguan (636), twenty-eight prefectures east of the Pass and along the Huai-Hai were inundated.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月癸未，黃氣際天，大雨，穀水溢，入洛陽宮，深四尺，壞左掖門，毀官寺十九；

translations.literal: On the day guimwei of the seventh month of the eleventh year, yellow qi reached the sky; great rain fell; the Gu River overflowed, entered the Luoyang palace, was four feet deep, destroyed the Left Flank Gate, and ruined nineteen official temples;
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei day in the seventh month of the eleventh year of Zhenguan (637), yellow vapor filled the sky; torrential rain fell; the Gu River overflowed into the Luoyang palace to a depth of four feet, destroying the Left Flank Gate and damaging nineteen government temples;

sentences.zh: 洛水漂六百餘家。

translations.literal: The Luo River swept away more than six hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: the Luo River swept away more than six hundred households.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，河溢，壞陝州之河北縣及太原倉，毀河陽中潬。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the ninth month, the Yellow River overflowed, destroyed Hebei County in Shaan Prefecture and the Taiyuan granary, and ruined the central embankment at Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the ninth month, the Yellow River overflowed, destroying Hebei County in Shaan Prefecture and the Taiyuan granary and ruining the central embankment at Heyang.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋，徐、戴二州大水。

translations.literal: In autumn of the sixteenth year, great floods in the two prefectures of Xu and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the sixteenth year of Zhenguan (642), great floods struck the prefectures of Xu and Dai.

sentences.zh: 十八年秋，穀、襄、豫、荊、徐、梓、忠、緜、宋、亳十州大水。

translations.literal: In autumn of the eighteenth year, great floods in the ten prefectures of Gu, Xiang, Yu, Jing, Xu, Zi, Zhong, Mian, Song, and Bo.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighteenth year of Zhenguan (644), great floods struck the ten prefectures of Gu, Xiang, Yu, Jing, Xu, Zi, Zhong, Mian, Song, and Bo.

sentences.zh: 十九年秋，沁、易二州水，害稼。

translations.literal: In autumn of the nineteenth year, floods in the two prefectures of Qin and Yi damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the nineteenth year of Zhenguan (645), floods in Qin and Yi prefectures damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十一年八月，河北大水，泉州海溢，驩州水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year, great floods in Hebei; the sea overflowed at Quan Prefecture; floods at Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year of Zhenguan (647), Hebei suffered great floods; the sea overflowed at Quan Prefecture; and Huan Prefecture was flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十二年夏，瀘、越、徐、交、渝等州水。

translations.literal: In summer of the twenty-second year, floods in the prefectures of Lu, Yue, Xu, Jiao, Yu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-second year of Zhenguan (648), floods struck Lu, Yue, Xu, Jiao, Yu, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 永徽元年六月，新豐、渭南大雨，零口山水暴出，漂廬舍；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Yonghui, great rain at Xinfeng and Weinan; mountain waters at Lingkou burst forth and swept away dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Yonghui (650), torrential rain fell at Xinfeng and Weinan; mountain waters at Lingkou burst forth and swept away dwellings;

sentences.zh: 宣、歙、饒、常等州大雨，水，溺死者數百人。

translations.literal: great rain in the prefectures of Xuan, She, Rao, Chang, and others; floods; several hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: torrential rain and floods in Xuan, She, Rao, Chang, and other prefectures drowned several hundred people.

sentences.zh: 秋，齊、定等州十六，水。

translations.literal: In autumn, sixteen prefectures including Qi and Ding suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, sixteen prefectures including Qi and Ding were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，汴、定、濮、亳等州水。

translations.literal: In autumn of the second year, floods in the prefectures of Bian, Ding, Pu, Bo, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year of Yonghui (651), floods struck Bian, Ding, Pu, Bo, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四年，杭、夔、果、忠等州水。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, floods in the prefectures of Hang, Kui, Guo, Zhong, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yonghui (653), floods struck Hang, Kui, Guo, Zhong, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五年五月丁丑夜，大雨，麟遊縣山水衝萬年宮玄武門，入寢殿，衞士有溺死者。

translations.literal: On the night of the day dingchou in the fifth month of the fifth year, great rain; mountain waters at Linyou County struck the Wannian Palace's Xuanwu Gate, entered the sleeping hall, and some guards drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingchou day in the fifth month of the fifth year of Yonghui (654), torrential rain sent mountain waters at Linyou County crashing through the Xuanwu Gate of Wannian Palace into the sleeping quarters; some guards drowned.

sentences.zh: 六月，河北大水，滹沱溢，損五千餘家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, great floods in Hebei; the Hutuo overflowed and damaged more than five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, great floods struck Hebei; the Hutuo River overflowed and damaged more than five thousand households.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，商州大水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, great flood at Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Yonghui (655), Shang Prefecture suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 秋，冀、沂、密、兗、滑、汴、鄭、婺等州水，害稼；

translations.literal: In autumn, floods in the prefectures of Ji, Yi, Mi, Yan, Hua, Bian, Zheng, Wu, and others damaged the crops;
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, floods in Ji, Yi, Mi, Yan, Hua, Bian, Zheng, Wu, and other prefectures damaged the harvest;

sentences.zh: 洛州大水，毀天津橋。

translations.literal: great flood at Luo Prefecture destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: a great flood at Luo Prefecture destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 十月，齊州河溢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the river at Qi Prefecture overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the river at Qi Prefecture overflowed.

sentences.zh: 顯慶元年七月，宣州涇縣山水暴出，平地四丈，溺死者二千餘人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Xianqing, mountain waters at Jing County in Xuan Prefecture burst forth; on level ground they were four zhang deep; more than two thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Xianqing (656), mountain waters burst forth at Jing County in Xuan Prefecture, reaching four zhang on level ground; more than two thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 九月，括州暴風雨，海水溢，壞安固、永嘉二縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, violent wind and rain at Kuo Prefecture; the sea overflowed and destroyed the two counties of Angu and Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, a violent storm at Kuo Prefecture sent the sea overflowing and destroyed Angu and Yongjia counties.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，連州山水暴出，漂七百餘家。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, mountain waters at Lian Prefecture burst forth and swept away more than seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Xianqing (659), mountain waters burst forth at Lian Prefecture and swept away more than seven hundred households.

sentences.zh: 麟德二年六月，鄜州大水，壞居人廬舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Linde, great flood at Fu Prefecture destroyed the dwellings of residents.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Linde (665), a great flood at Fu Prefecture destroyed residents' dwellings.

sentences.zh: 總章二年六月，括州大風雨，海溢，壞永嘉、安固二縣，溺死者九千七十人；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Zongzhang, violent wind and rain at Kuo Prefecture; the sea overflowed and destroyed the two counties of Yongjia and Angu; nine thousand seventy drowned;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Zongzhang (669), a violent storm at Kuo Prefecture sent the sea overflowing and destroyed Yongjia and Angu counties; nine thousand seventy people drowned;

sentences.zh: 冀州大雨，水平地深一丈，壞民居萬家。

translations.literal: great rain at Ji Prefecture; on level ground the water was one zhang deep and destroyed ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: torrential rain at Ji Prefecture left level ground one zhang deep in water and destroyed ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年五月丙戌，大雨，山水溢，溺死五千餘人。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu of the fifth month of the first year of Xianheng, great rain; mountain waters overflowed and more than five thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the fifth month of the first year of Xianheng (670), torrential rain sent mountain waters overflowing and drowned more than five thousand people.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，徐州山水漂百餘家。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, mountain waters at Xu Prefecture swept away more than a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Xianheng (671), mountain waters at Xu Prefecture swept away more than a hundred households.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，婺州大雨，山水暴漲，溺死五千餘人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, great rain at Wu Prefecture; mountain waters surged violently and more than five thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Xianheng (673), torrential rain at Wu Prefecture sent mountain waters surging violently and drowned more than five thousand people.

sentences.zh: 上元三年八月，青州大風，海溢，漂居人五千餘家；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Shangyuan, great wind at Qing Prefecture; the sea overflowed and swept away more than five thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Shangyuan (676), a great gale at Qing Prefecture sent the sea overflowing and swept away more than five thousand households;

sentences.zh: 齊、淄等七州大水。

translations.literal: great floods in the seven prefectures of Qi, Zi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: great floods struck the seven prefectures of Qi, Zi, and others.

sentences.zh: 永隆元年九月，河南、河北大水，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Yonglong, great floods in Henan and Hebei; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Yonglong (680), great floods in Henan and Hebei drowned a great many people.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，河南、河北大水，壞民居十萬餘家。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, great floods in Henan and Hebei destroyed more than a hundred thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Yonglong (681), great floods in Henan and Hebei destroyed more than a hundred thousand households.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年五月丙午，東都連日澍雨；

translations.literal: On the day bingwu of the fifth month of the first year of Yongchun, the Eastern Capital had continuous soaking rain for days;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the fifth month of the first year of Yongchun (682), the Eastern Capital endured days of soaking rain;

sentences.zh: 乙卯，洛水溢，壞天津橋及中橋，漂居民千餘家。

translations.literal: on the day yimao, the Luo River overflowed, destroyed the Tianjin and Central bridges, and swept away more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: on yimao day the Luo River overflowed, destroying the Tianjin and Central bridges and sweeping away more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，京師大雨，水平地深數尺。

translations.literal: On the day yihai of the sixth month, great rain in the capital; on level ground the water was several chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the sixth month, torrential rain in the capital left level ground several chi deep in water.

sentences.zh: 秋，山東大雨，水，大饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, great rain in Shandong; floods; severe famine.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, torrential rain and floods in Shandong brought severe famine.

sentences.zh: 二年七月己巳，河溢，壞河陽橋。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the seventh month of the second year, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed the Heyang Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the seventh month of the second year of Yongchun (683), the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed the Heyang Bridge.

sentences.zh: 八月，恆州滹沱河及山水暴溢，害稼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Hutuo River and mountain waters at Heng Prefecture burst forth violently and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Hutuo River and mountain waters at Heng Prefecture burst forth violently and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 文明元年七月，溫州大水，漂千餘家；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Wenming, great flood at Wen Prefecture swept away more than a thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Wenming (684), a great flood at Wen Prefecture swept away more than a thousand households;

sentences.zh: 括州溪水暴漲，溺死百餘人。

translations.literal: at Kuo Prefecture stream waters surged violently and more than a hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: at Kuo Prefecture stream waters surged violently and drowned more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 如意元年四月，洛水溢，壞永昌橋，漂居民四百餘家。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Ruyi, the Luo River overflowed, destroyed the Yongchang Bridge, and swept away more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Ruyi (692), the Luo River overflowed, destroying the Yongchang Bridge and sweeping away more than four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 七月，洛水溢，漂居民五千餘家。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Luo River overflowed and swept away more than five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Luo River overflowed and swept away more than five thousand households.

sentences.zh: 八月，河溢，壞河陽縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang County.

sentences.zh: 長壽二年五月，棣州河溢，壞居民二千餘家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Changshou, the river at Di Prefecture overflowed and destroyed more than two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Changshou (693), the river at Di Prefecture overflowed and destroyed more than two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南州十一，水。

translations.literal: That year, eleven prefectures in Henan suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eleven prefectures in Henan were flooded.

sentences.zh: 萬歲通天元年八月，徐州大水，害稼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Wansui Tongtian, great flood at Xu Prefecture damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Wansui Tongtian (696), a great flood at Xu Prefecture damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 神功元年三月，括州水，壞民居七百餘家。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Shengong, floods at Kuo Prefecture destroyed more than seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Shengong (697), floods at Kuo Prefecture destroyed more than seven hundred households.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南州十九，水。

translations.literal: That year, nineteen prefectures in Henan suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year, nineteen prefectures in Henan were flooded.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年七月丙辰，神都大雨，洛水壞天津橋。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen of the seventh month of the second year of Shengli, great rain in the Divine Capital; the Luo River destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the seventh month of the second year of Shengli (699), torrential rain in the Divine Capital sent the Luo River destroying the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 秋，河溢懷州，漂千餘家。

translations.literal: In autumn, the Yellow River overflowed at Huai Prefecture and swept away more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the Yellow River overflowed at Huai Prefecture and swept away more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛亥，鴻州水，漂千餘家，溺死四百餘人。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the third month of the third year, floods at Hong Prefecture swept away more than a thousand households and drowned more than four hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the third month of the third year of Shengli (700), floods at Hong Prefecture swept away more than a thousand households and drowned more than four hundred people.

sentences.zh: 久視元年十月，洛州水。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Jiushi, floods at Luo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Jiushi (700), Luo Prefecture was flooded.

sentences.zh: 長安三年六月，寧州大雨，水，漂二千餘家，溺死千餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Chang'an, great rain at Ning Prefecture; floods swept away more than two thousand households and drowned more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of Chang'an (703), torrential rain and floods at Ning Prefecture swept away more than two thousand households and drowned more than a thousand people.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，瀛州水，壞民居數千家。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, floods at Ying Prefecture destroyed several thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Chang'an (704), floods at Ying Prefecture destroyed several thousand households.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年四月，雍州同官縣大雨，水，漂居民五百餘家。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Shenlong, great rain at Tongguan County in Yong Prefecture; floods swept away more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Shenlong (705), torrential rain and floods at Tongguan County in Yong Prefecture swept away more than five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 六月，河北州十七，大水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, seventeen prefectures in Hebei suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, seventeen prefectures in Hebei were struck by great floods.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，洛水溢，壞民居二千餘家。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the seventh month, the Luo River overflowed and destroyed more than two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the seventh month, the Luo River overflowed and destroyed more than two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二年四月辛丑，洛水壞天津橋，溺死數百人。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the fourth month of the second year, the Luo River destroyed the Tianjin Bridge and several hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the fourth month of the second year of Shenlong (706), the Luo River destroyed the Tianjin Bridge and drowned several hundred people.

sentences.zh: 八月，魏州水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, floods at Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Wei Prefecture was flooded.

sentences.zh: 景龍三年七月，澧水溢，害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Jinglong, the Li River overflowed and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Jinglong (709), the Li River overflowed and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 九月，密州水，壞民居數百家。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, floods at Mi Prefecture destroyed several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, floods at Mi Prefecture destroyed several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 開元三年，河南、河北水。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaiyuan, floods in Henan and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaiyuan (715), Henan and Hebei were flooded.

sentences.zh: 四年七月丁酉，洛水溢，沈舟數百艘。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the seventh month of the fourth year, the Luo River overflowed and sank several hundred boats.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the seventh month of the fourth year of Kaiyuan (716), the Luo River overflowed and sank several hundred boats.

sentences.zh: 五年六月甲申，瀍水溢，溺死者千餘人；

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the sixth month of the fifth year, the Chan River overflowed and more than a thousand drowned;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the sixth month of the fifth year of Kaiyuan (717), the Chan River overflowed and drowned more than a thousand people;

sentences.zh: 鞏縣大水，壞城邑，損居民數百家；

translations.literal: great flood at Gong County destroyed the walled town and damaged several hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: a great flood at Gong County destroyed the walled town and damaged several hundred households;

sentences.zh: 河南水，害稼。

translations.literal: floods in Henan damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: floods in Henan damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八年夏，契丹寇營州，發關中卒援之，宿澠池之缺門，營穀水上，夜半，山水暴至，萬餘人皆溺死。

translations.literal: In summer of the eighth year, the Khitan raided Ying Prefecture; troops from Guanzhong were sent to relieve it; they encamped at Que Gate in Mianchi on the waters of the Gu River; at midnight mountain waters burst forth and more than ten thousand all drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eighth year of Kaiyuan (720), the Khitan raided Ying Prefecture; Guanzhong troops were sent to relieve it and encamped at Que Gate in Mianchi on the Gu River; at midnight mountain waters burst forth and drowned more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅夜，穀、洛溢，入西上陽宮，宮人死者十七八，畿內諸縣田稼廬舍蕩盡，掌閑衞兵溺死千餘人，京師興道坊一夕陷為池，居民五百餘家皆沒不見。

translations.literal: On the night of the day gengyin in the sixth month, the Gu and Luo overflowed, entered the Western Shangyang Palace; seven or eight out of ten palace women died; in the capital districts fields, crops, and dwellings were utterly swept away; more than a thousand guards of the Palm Garden drowned; in the capital the Xingdao ward in one night sank into a pool and more than five hundred households vanished without trace.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengyin day in the sixth month, the Gu and Luo rivers overflowed into the Western Shangyang Palace; seven or eight out of ten palace women perished; throughout the capital districts fields, crops, and dwellings were utterly destroyed; more than a thousand Palm Garden guards drowned; in the capital the Xingdao ward sank overnight into a pool, and more than five hundred households vanished without trace.

sentences.zh: 是年，鄧州三鴉口大水塞谷，或見二小兒以水相沃，須臾，有蛇大十圍，張口仰天，人或斫射之，俄而暴雷雨，漂溺數百家。

translations.literal: That year, at Sanya Pass in Deng Prefecture great flood waters blocked the valley; some saw two small boys dousing each other with water; in a moment a serpent ten arm-spans around appeared, mouth open toward the sky; people hacked and shot at it; soon violent thunder and rain came and several hundred households were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at Sanya Pass in Deng Prefecture a great flood blocked the valley; some reported seeing two small boys splashing water on each other; presently a serpent ten arm-spans thick appeared with its mouth open to the sky; people hacked and shot at it; soon a violent thunderstorm came and swept away and drowned several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十年五月辛酉，伊水溢，毀東都城東南隅，平地深六尺；

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the fifth month of the tenth year, the Yi River overflowed and destroyed the southeastern corner of the Eastern Capital; on level ground the water was six chi deep;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the fifth month of the tenth year of Kaiyuan (722), the Yi River overflowed and destroyed the southeastern corner of the Eastern Capital, leaving level ground six chi deep in water;

sentences.zh: 河南許、仙、豫、陳、汝、唐、鄧等州大水，害稼，漂沒民居，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: great floods in the prefectures of Xu, Xian, Yu, Chen, Ru, Tang, Deng, and others in Henan damaged the crops, swept away dwellings, and very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: great floods in Xu, Xian, Yu, Chen, Ru, Tang, Deng, and other prefectures in Henan damaged the harvest, swept away dwellings, and drowned a great many people.

sentences.zh: 六月，博州、棣州河決。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the rivers at Bo and Di prefectures burst their banks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the rivers at Bo and Di prefectures burst their banks.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，豫州大水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, great flood at Yu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year of Kaiyuan (724), Yu Prefecture suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 八月，兗州大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, great flood at Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yan Prefecture suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋，天下州五十，水，河南、河北尤甚，河及支川皆溢，懷、衞、鄭、滑、汴、濮人或巢或舟以居，死者千計；

translations.literal: In autumn of the fourteenth year, fifty prefectures throughout the realm suffered floods; Henan and Hebei were especially severe; the Yellow River and its branches all overflowed; in Huai, Wei, Zheng, Hua, Bian, and Pu some lived in nests or boats; deaths numbered in the thousands;
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourteenth year of Kaiyuan (726), fifty prefectures throughout the realm were flooded; Henan and Hebei were hardest hit; the Yellow River and all its branches overflowed; in Huai, Wei, Zheng, Hua, Bian, and Pu people dwelt in nests or boats; deaths numbered in the thousands;

sentences.zh: 潤州大風自東北，海濤沒瓜步。

translations.literal: At Run Prefecture a great wind came from the northeast and sea waves submerged Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: At Run Prefecture a great gale from the northeast sent sea waves submerging Guabu.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，晉州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, great flood at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year of Kaiyuan (727), Jin Prefecture suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 七月，鄧州大水，溺死數千人；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, great flood at Deng Prefecture; several thousand drowned;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a great flood at Deng Prefecture drowned several thousand people;

sentences.zh: 洛水溢，入鄜城，平地丈餘，死者無算，壞同州城市及馮翊縣，漂居民二千餘家。

translations.literal: the Luo River overflowed, entered Fucheng, on level ground more than one zhang; the dead were beyond counting; it destroyed the walled city of Tong Prefecture and Fengyi County and swept away more than two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: the Luo River overflowed into Fucheng to more than one zhang on level ground; the dead were beyond counting; it destroyed the walled city of Tong Prefecture and Fengyi County and swept away more than two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 八月，澗、穀溢，毀澠池縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Jian and Gu overflowed and destroyed Mianchi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Jian and Gu rivers overflowed and destroyed Mianchi County.

sentences.zh: 是秋，天下州六十三，大水，害稼及居人廬舍，河北尤甚。

translations.literal: That autumn, sixty-three prefectures throughout the realm suffered great floods, damaging crops and dwellings; Hebei was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, sixty-three prefectures throughout the realm suffered great floods, damaging harvests and dwellings; Hebei was hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月丙寅，越州大水，壞州縣城。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin of the eighth month of the seventeenth year, great flood at Yue Prefecture destroyed the prefectural and county seats.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan (729), a great flood at Yue Prefecture destroyed the prefectural and county seats.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月壬午，東都瀍水溺揚、楚等州租船，洛水壞天津、永濟二橋及民居千餘家。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the sixth month of the eighteenth year, at the Eastern Capital the Chan River drowned the grain-tax boats of Yang, Chu, and other prefectures; the Luo River destroyed the Tianjin and Yongji bridges and more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the sixth month of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan (730), at the Eastern Capital the Chan River drowned the grain-tax boats of Yang, Chu, and other prefectures; the Luo River destroyed the Tianjin and Yongji bridges and more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 十九年秋，河南水，害稼。

translations.literal: In autumn of the nineteenth year, floods in Henan damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the nineteenth year of Kaiyuan (731), floods in Henan damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十年秋，宋、滑、兗、鄆等州大水。

translations.literal: In autumn of the twentieth year, great floods in the prefectures of Song, Hua, Yan, Yun, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twentieth year of Kaiyuan (732), great floods struck Song, Hua, Yan, Yun, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二十二年秋，關輔、河南州十餘，水，害稼。

translations.literal: In autumn of the twenty-second year, more than ten prefectures in Guanfu and Henan suffered floods that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-second year of Kaiyuan (734), more than ten prefectures in Guanfu and Henan were flooded and the harvest was damaged.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，澧、袁、江等州水。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, floods in the prefectures of Li, Yuan, Jiang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year of Kaiyuan (739), Li, Yuan, Jiang, and other prefectures were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十月，河南郡十三，水。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-eighth year, thirteen commanderies of Henan suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-eighth year of Kaiyuan (740), thirteen commanderies of Henan were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十九年七月，伊、洛及支川皆溢，害稼，毀天津橋及東西漕、上陽宮仗舍，溺死千餘人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-ninth year, the Yi, Luo, and tributary streams all overflowed, damaging crops; they destroyed the Tianjin Bridge and the eastern and western grain-transport canals and the guard quarters of Shangyang Palace; more than a thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-ninth year of Kaiyuan (741), the Yi, Luo, and tributary streams all overflowed and damaged the harvest; they destroyed the Tianjin Bridge and the eastern and western grain-transport canals and the guard quarters of Shangyang Palace, and more than a thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河南、河北郡二十四，水，害稼。

translations.literal: That autumn, twenty-four commanderies of Henan and Hebei suffered floods that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, twenty-four commanderies of Henan and Hebei were flooded and the harvest was damaged.

sentences.zh: 天寶四載|745年九月，河南、淮陽、睢陽、譙四郡水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Tianbao, the four commanderies of Henan, Huaiyang, Suiyang, and Qiao suffered floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Tianbao (745), Henan, Huaiyang, Suiyang, and Qiao commanderies were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十載，廣陵大風駕海潮，沈江口船數千艘。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, at Guangling a great wind drove the sea tide; several thousand ships at the river mouth were sunk.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tianbao (751), a great wind at Guangling drove the sea tide and sank several thousand ships at the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 十三載九月，東都瀍、洛溢，壞十九坊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, at the Eastern Capital the Chan and Luo overflowed and destroyed nineteen wards.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year of Tianbao (754), at the Eastern Capital the Chan and Luo rivers overflowed and destroyed nineteen wards.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年九月，大雨，水平地數尺，時吐蕃寇京畿，以水自潰去。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Guangde, heavy rain; water on level ground was several chi; at the time Tibetans were raiding the capital region and dispersed of their own accord because of the water.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Guangde (763), heavy rain left several chi of water on level ground; at the time Tibetans were raiding the capital region and broke up on their own because of the flood.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，東都大雨，洛水溢，漂二十餘坊；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, heavy rain at the Eastern Capital; the Luo River overflowed and swept away more than twenty wards;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Guangde (764), heavy rain at the Eastern Capital; the Luo River overflowed and swept away more than twenty wards;

sentences.zh: 河南諸州水。

translations.literal: floods in the prefectures of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: floods struck the prefectures of Henan.

sentences.zh: 大曆元年七月，洛水溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Dali, the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Dali (766), the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，湖南及河東、河南、淮南、浙東西、福建等道州五十五水災。

translations.literal: In autumn of the second year, fifty-five prefectures in Hunan and the circuits of Hedong, Henan, Huainan, eastern and western Zhe, Fujian, and others suffered flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year of Dali (767), fifty-five prefectures in Hunan and the circuits of Hedong, Henan, Huainan, eastern and western Zhe, Fujian, and elsewhere suffered flood disasters.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，江州江溢。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, the river at Jiang Prefecture overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year of Dali (772), the river at Jiang Prefecture overflowed.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，杭州海溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, the sea at Hang Prefecture overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year of Dali (775), the sea overflowed at Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月戊子，夜澍雨，京師平地水尺餘，溝渠漲溢，壞民居千餘家。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the seventh month of the eleventh year, torrential rain at night; at the capital water on level ground was more than a chi; ditches and canals surged and overflowed, destroying more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the seventh month of the eleventh year of Dali (776), torrential rain at night left more than a chi of water on level ground at the capital; ditches and canals surged and overflowed and destroyed more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 十二年秋，京畿及宋、亳、滑三州大雨水，害稼，河南尤甚，平地深五尺，河溢。

translations.literal: In autumn of the twelfth year, the capital region and the three prefectures of Song, Bo, and Hua suffered great rain and water that damaged crops; Henan was especially severe, on level ground five chi deep, and the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twelfth year of Dali (777), the capital region and Song, Bo, and Hua prefectures suffered great rain and flooding that damaged the harvest; Henan was hardest hit, with five chi on level ground, and the river overflowed.

sentences.zh: 建中元年，幽、鎮、魏、博大雨，易水、滹沱橫流，自山而下，轉石折樹，水高丈餘，苗稼蕩盡。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong, heavy rain in You, Zhen, Wei, and Bo; the Yi River and Hutuo flowed crosswise, coming down from the mountains, turning stones and breaking trees; water was more than one zhang high, and seedlings and crops were entirely swept away.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianzhong (780), heavy rain in You, Zhen, Wei, and Bo sent the Yi River and Hutuo flowing crosswise down from the mountains, turning stones and breaking trees; the water stood more than one zhang high and seedlings and crops were entirely swept away.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年六月丁酉，大風雨，京城通衢水深數尺，有溺死者。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the sixth month of the second year of Zhenyuan, great wind and rain; water in the capital thoroughfares was several chi deep, and there were drowned dead.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the sixth month of the second year of Zhenyuan (786), great wind and rain left several chi of water in the capital thoroughfares, and some people drowned.

sentences.zh: 東都、河南、荊南、淮南江河溢。

translations.literal: at the Eastern Capital, Henan, Jingnan, and Huainan, rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: At the Eastern Capital and in Henan, Jingnan, and Huainan, rivers overflowed.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，東都、河南、江陵、汴揚等州大水。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, great floods at the Eastern Capital, Henan, Jiangling, Bian-Yang, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Zhenyuan (787), great floods struck the Eastern Capital, Henan, Jiangling, Bian-Yang, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，灞水暴溢，殺百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, the Ba River suddenly overflowed and killed more than a hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Zhenyuan (788), the Ba River suddenly overflowed and killed more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，自江淮及荊、襄、陳、宋至于河朔州四十餘，大水，害稼，溺死二萬餘人，漂沒城郭廬舍，幽州平地水深二丈，徐、鄭、涿、薊、檀、平等州，皆深丈餘。

translations.literal: In autumn of the eighth year, from the Jiang-Huai region and Jing, Xiang, Chen, Song, on to more than forty prefectures in Hebei, great floods damaged crops; more than twenty thousand drowned; walled cities and dwellings were swept away; at You Prefecture water on level ground was two zhang deep; at Xu, Zheng, Zhuo, Ji, Tan, Ping, and other prefectures all were more than one zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year of Zhenyuan (792), more than forty prefectures from the Jiang-Huai region and Jing, Xiang, Chen, and Song north to Hebei suffered great floods that damaged the harvest; more than twenty thousand people drowned; walled cities and dwellings were swept away; at You Prefecture water on level ground stood two zhang; Xu, Zheng, Zhuo, Ji, Tan, Ping, and other prefectures were all more than one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，淮水溢，平地七尺，沒泗州城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year, the Huai River overflowed, seven chi on level ground, and submerged Sizhou walled city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of Zhenyuan (792), the Huai River overflowed to seven chi on level ground and submerged the walled city of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一年十月，朗、蜀二州江溢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eleventh year, rivers at Lang and Shu prefectures overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Zhenyuan (795), rivers at Lang and Shu prefectures overflowed.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，福、建二州大水，嵐州暴雨，水深二丈。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, great floods in Fu and Jian prefectures; at Lan Prefecture torrential rain, water two zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year of Zhenyuan (796), great floods struck Fu and Jian prefectures; at Lan Prefecture torrential rain left water two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，淮水溢于亳州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, the Huai River overflowed into Bo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year of Zhenyuan (797), the Huai River overflowed into Bo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十八年春，申、光、蔡等州大水。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighteenth year, great floods in Shen, Guang, Cai, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighteenth year of Zhenyuan (802), Shen, Guang, Cai, and other prefectures suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 永貞元年夏，朗州之熊、武五溪溢。

translations.literal: In summer of the first year of Yongzhen, the five streams of Xiong and Wu in Lang Prefecture overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Yongzhen (805), the five streams of Xiong and Wu in Lang Prefecture overflowed.

sentences.zh: 秋，武陵、龍陽二縣江水溢，漂萬餘家。

translations.literal: In autumn, rivers at Wuling and Longyang counties overflowed and swept away more than ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn, rivers at Wuling and Longyang counties overflowed and swept away more than ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 京畿長安等九縣山水害稼。

translations.literal: Mountain floods in nine counties including Chang'an in the capital region damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain floods in nine counties of the capital region including Chang'an damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 元和元年夏，荊南及壽、幽、徐等州大水。

translations.literal: In summer of the first year of Yuanhe, great floods in Jingnan and Shou, You, Xu, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Yuanhe (806), Jingnan and Shou, You, Xu, and other prefectures suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，蔡州大雨，水平地深數尺。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year, heavy rain at Cai Prefecture; on level ground several chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Yuanhe (807), heavy rain at Cai Prefecture left several chi of water on level ground.

sentences.zh: 四年十月丁未，渭南暴水，漂民居二百餘家。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the tenth month of the fourth year, sudden flood at Weinan swept away more than two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuanhe (809), a sudden flood at Weinan swept away more than two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，鄜坊、黔中水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, floods in Zhenfang and Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Yuanhe (811), floods struck Zhenfang and Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，振武河溢，毀東受降城；

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, the Zhenwu River overflowed and destroyed the Eastern Surrender City;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year of Yuanhe (812), the Zhenwu River overflowed and destroyed the Eastern Surrender City;

sentences.zh: 五月，饒、撫、虔、吉、信五州暴水，虔州尤甚，平地有深至四丈者。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, sudden floods in the five prefectures of Rao, Fu, Qian, Ji, and Xin; Qian Prefecture especially, on level ground in places as deep as four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, sudden floods struck Rao, Fu, Qian, Ji, and Xin prefectures; Qian Prefecture especially saw level ground in places as deep as four zhang.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，陳州、許州大雨，大隗山摧，水流出，溺死者千餘人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, heavy rain at Chen and Xu prefectures; Mount Da Wei collapsed, water flowed out, and more than a thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year of Yuanhe (813), heavy rain at Chen and Xu prefectures collapsed Mount Da Wei; water poured out and more than a thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，大風，毀屋揚瓦，人多壓死；

translations.literal: On the day gengyin of the sixth month, great wind destroyed houses and blew off tiles; many were crushed to death;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the sixth month, a great wind destroyed houses and blew off roof tiles; many people were crushed to death;

sentences.zh: 京師大水，城南深丈餘，入明德門，猶漸車輻。

translations.literal: great flood at the capital; south of the city more than one zhang deep; it entered the Mingde Gate and still reached the wheel hubs.
translations.idiomatic: a great flood at the capital left more than one zhang south of the city; water entered the Mingde Gate and still came up to the wheel hubs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，渭水漲，絕濟。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Wei River rose and ferry service was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Wei River rose and ferry service was cut off.

sentences.zh: 時所在百川發溢，多不由故道。

translations.literal: At the time the hundred streams everywhere burst forth and overflowed, many not following their old courses.
translations.idiomatic: At the time streams everywhere burst forth and overflowed, many not following their old channels.

sentences.zh: 滄州水潦，浸鹽山等四縣。

translations.literal: Floods at Cang Prefecture inundated four counties including Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Cang Prefecture inundated four counties including Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，淮南及岳、安、宣、江、撫、袁等州大水，害稼。

translations.literal: In autumn of the ninth year, great floods in Huainan and Yue, An, Xuan, Jiang, Fu, Yuan, and other prefectures damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year of Yuanhe (814), great floods in Huainan and Yue, An, Xuan, Jiang, Fu, Yuan, and other prefectures damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，京畿大雨水，昭應尤甚；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, heavy rain in the capital region; Zhaoying especially severe;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Yuanhe (816), heavy rain in the capital region; Zhaoying was especially hard hit;

sentences.zh: 衢州山水害稼，深三丈，毀州郭，溺死百餘人。

translations.literal: mountain floods at Qu Prefecture damaged crops, three zhang deep; destroyed the prefectural seat; more than a hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: mountain floods at Qu Prefecture damaged the harvest to a depth of three zhang, destroyed the prefectural seat, and drowned more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 六月，密州大風雨，海溢，毀城郭；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, at Mi Prefecture great wind and rain; the sea overflowed and destroyed the walled city;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, great wind and rain at Mi Prefecture sent the sea overflowing and destroyed the walled city;

sentences.zh: 饒州浮梁、樂平二縣暴雨，水，漂沒四千餘戶；

translations.literal: at Rao Prefecture, torrential rain in Fuliang and Leping counties; floods swept away more than four thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: at Rao Prefecture, torrential rain in Fuliang and Leping counties brought floods that swept away more than four thousand households;

sentences.zh: 潤、常、潮、陳、許五州及京畿水，害稼。

translations.literal: floods in the five prefectures of Run, Chang, Chao, Chen, and Xu and the capital region damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Run, Chang, Chao, Chen, and Xu prefectures and the capital region were flooded and the harvest was damaged.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，渭水溢，毀中橋。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the eighth month, the Wei River overflowed and destroyed the Central Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the eighth month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe (817), the Wei River overflowed and destroyed the Central Bridge.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月乙酉，京師大雨，水，含元殿一柱傾，市中水深三尺，毀民居二千餘家；

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the sixth month of the twelfth year, heavy rain at the capital; flood; one pillar of the Hanyuan Hall tilted; water in the market three chi deep; destroyed more than two thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the sixth month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe (817), heavy rain at the capital flooded; one pillar of Hanyuan Hall tilted; water in the market stood three chi deep and destroyed more than two thousand households;

sentences.zh: 河南、河北大水，洺、邢尤甚，平地二丈；

translations.literal: great floods in Henan and Hebei; Ming and Xing especially severe, two zhang on level ground;
translations.idiomatic: great floods in Henan and Hebei; Ming and Xing were hardest hit, with two zhang on level ground;

sentences.zh: 河中、江陵、幽澤潞晉隰蘇台越州水，害稼。

translations.literal: Hezhong, Jiangling, You, Ze, Lu, Jin, Xi, Su, Tai, and Yue prefectures had water, damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: floods struck Hezhong, Jiangling, You, Ze, Lu, Jin, Xi, Su, Tai, and Yue prefectures and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月辛未，淮水溢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirteenth year of Yuanhe (818), on xinwei day, the Huai River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirteenth year of Yuanhe (818), on xinwei day, the Huai River overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 十五年秋，洪、吉、信、滄等州水。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fifteenth year of Yuanhe (820), Hong, Ji, Xin, and Cang prefectures had water.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fifteenth year of Yuanhe (820), floods struck Hong, Ji, Xin, and Cang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年七月，河南陳、許、蔡等州大水；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Changqing (822), Chen, Xu, Cai, and other prefectures of Henan suffered great flood;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Changqing (822), Chen, Xu, Cai, and other Henan prefectures were inundated;

sentences.zh: 好畤山水漂民居三百餘家；

translations.literal: at Haozhi, mountain waters swept away more than three hundred dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: at Haozhi, flash floods swept away more than three hundred households;

sentences.zh: 處州大雨，水，平地深八尺，壞城邑、桑田太半。

translations.literal: Chu Prefecture had great rain and water; on level ground the depth was eight chi, destroying more than half the cities, towns, and mulberry fields.
translations.idiomatic: At Chu Prefecture torrential rain sent floodwaters eight chi deep across the flats, destroying more than half the walled towns and mulberry plantations.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，蘇、湖二州大雨，水，太湖決溢；

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year of Changqing (824), Su and Hu prefectures had great rain and water, and Tai Lake burst its banks;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fourth year of Changqing (824), Su and Hu prefectures were deluged, and Lake Tai burst its banks;

sentences.zh: 睦州及壽州之霍山山水暴出；

translations.literal: at Mu Prefecture and Huoshan in Shou Prefecture, mountain waters burst forth violently;
translations.idiomatic: flash floods erupted in Mu Prefecture and at Huoshan in Shou Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 鄆、曹、濮三州雨，水壞州城、民居、田稼略盡；

translations.literal: Yun, Cao, and Pu prefectures had rain; water nearly destroyed city walls, dwellings, and field crops;
translations.idiomatic: Yun, Cao, and Pu prefectures were soaked by rain until floodwaters all but destroyed their city walls, homes, and crops;

sentences.zh: 襄、均、復、郢四州漢水溢決。

translations.literal: Xiang, Jun, Fu, and Ying prefectures—the Han River overflowed and burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: and the Han River overflowed and broke its banks at Xiang, Jun, Fu, and Ying prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秋，河南及陳、許二州水，害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn, Henan and Chen and Xu prefectures had water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn floods struck Henan and Chen and Xu prefectures and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 寶曆元年秋，鄜、坊二州暴水；

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Baoli (825), Fu and Fang prefectures had violent water;
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Baoli (825), Fu and Fang prefectures were struck by flash floods;

sentences.zh: 兗、海、華三州及京畿奉天等六縣水，害稼。

translations.literal: Yan, Hai, and Hua prefectures and six counties of the capital region including Fengtian had water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, Hai, and Hua prefectures and six counties of the metropolitan region including Fengtian flooded and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 大和二年夏，京畿及陳、滑二州水，害稼；

translations.literal: In the summer of the second year of Dahe (828), the capital region and Chen and Hua prefectures had water, damaging crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the second year of Dahe (828), the capital region and Chen and Hua prefectures flooded and damaged crops;

sentences.zh: 河陽水，平地五尺；

translations.literal: at Heyang the water on level ground was five chi;
translations.idiomatic: at Heyang floodwaters on the flats stood five chi deep;

sentences.zh: 河決，壞棣州城；

translations.literal: the river burst its banks, destroying Di Prefecture's city wall;
translations.idiomatic: the Yellow River breached its banks and destroyed the wall of Di Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 越州大風，海溢；

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture had great wind, and the sea overflowed;
translations.idiomatic: a great storm at Yue Prefecture drove the sea over its banks;

sentences.zh: 河南鄆、曹、濮、淄、青、齊、德、兗、海等州並大水。

translations.literal: Yun, Cao, Pu, Zi, Qing, Qi, De, Yan, Hai, and other prefectures of Henan all had great water.
translations.idiomatic: and great floods struck Yun, Cao, Pu, Zi, Qing, Qi, De, Yan, Hai, and other prefectures across Henan.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，同官縣暴水，漂沒三百餘家；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Dahe (829), Tongguan County had violent water, sweeping away more than three hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Dahe (829), a flash flood at Tongguan County swept away more than three hundred households;

sentences.zh: 宋、亳、徐等州大水，害稼。

translations.literal: Song, Bo, and Xu prefectures had great water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: Song, Bo, and Xu prefectures were inundated and the harvest was ruined.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，江水溢，沒舒州太湖、宿松、望江三縣民田數百戶；

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year of Dahe (830), the Yangzi overflowed, inundating several hundred households' farmland in Tai Lake at Shu Prefecture and in Susong and Wangjiang counties;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fourth year of Dahe (830), the Yangzi rose and submerged the fields of several hundred households around Lake Tai in Shu Prefecture and in Susong and Wangjiang counties;

sentences.zh: 鄜、坊水，漂三百餘家；

translations.literal: Fu and Fang had water, sweeping away more than three hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Fu and Fang were flooded, carrying off more than three hundred households;

sentences.zh: 浙西、浙東、宣歙、江西、鄜坊、山南東道、淮南、京畿、河南、江南、荊襄、鄂岳、湖南大水，皆害稼。

translations.literal: Zhexi, Zhedong, Xuan-She, Jiangxi, Fu-Fang, Shannan East Circuit, Huainan, capital region, Henan, Jiangnan, Jingxiang, Eyue, and Hunan had great water, all damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: and catastrophic flooding across Zhexi, Zhedong, Xuan-She, Jiangxi, Fu-Fang, Shannan East Circuit, Huainan, the metropolitan region, Henan, Jiangnan, Jingxiang, Eyue, and Hunan ravaged the harvest everywhere.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，玄武江漲，高二丈，溢入梓州羅城；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Dahe (831), the Xuanwu River rose to a height of two zhang and overflowed into Zizhou's outer walled city;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Dahe (831), the Xuanwu River rose two zhang and poured into the outer wall of Zizhou;

sentences.zh: 淮西、浙東、浙西、荊襄、岳鄂、東川大水，害稼。

translations.literal: Huaixi, Zhedong, Zhexi, Jingxiang, Yue-E, and Dongchuan had great water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods in Huaixi, Zhedong, Zhexi, Jingxiang, Yue-E, and Dongchuan damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，蘇、湖二州大水。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year of Dahe (832), Su and Hu prefectures had great water.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year of Dahe (832), Su and Hu prefectures suffered major flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月，徐州大雨，壞民居九百餘家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Xuzhou had great rain, destroying more than nine hundred households' dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month torrential rain at Xuzhou destroyed more than nine hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 七年秋，浙西及揚、楚、舒、廬、壽、滁、和、宣等州大水，害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the seventh year of Dahe (833), Zhexi and Yang, Chu, Shu, Lu, Shou, Chuzhou, He, and Xuan prefectures had great water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the seventh year of Dahe (833), Zhexi and Yang, Chu, Shu, Lu, Shou, Chuzhou, He, and Xuan prefectures were inundated and the harvest suffered.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，江西及襄州水，害稼；

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year of Dahe (834), Jiangxi and Xiang Prefecture had water, damaging crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year of Dahe (834), Jiangxi and Xiang Prefecture flooded and damaged the harvest;

sentences.zh: 蘄州湖水溢；

translations.literal: Qi Prefecture's lake water overflowed;
translations.idiomatic: the lakes at Qi Prefecture burst their banks;

sentences.zh: 滁州大水，溺萬餘戶。

translations.literal: Chu Prefecture had great water; more than ten thousand households drowned.
translations.idiomatic: and a great flood at Chuzhou drowned more than ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 開成元年夏，鳳翔麟遊縣暴雨，水，毀九成宮，壞民舍數百家，死者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Kaicheng (836), at Linyou County in Fengxiang a violent rainstorm sent water that destroyed Jiucheng Palace, destroyed several hundred households' dwellings, and killed more than a hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Kaicheng (836), a cloudburst at Linyou County in Fengxiang unleashed floods that wrecked Jiucheng Palace, destroyed several hundred homes, and killed more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 七月，鎮州滹沱河溢，害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Hutuo River at Zhen Prefecture overflowed, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Hutuo River overflowed at Zhen Prefecture and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，河決，浸鄭、滑外城；

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Kaicheng (838), the Yellow River burst its banks, inundating the outer walls of Zheng and Hua;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of Kaicheng (838), the Yellow River breached its banks and flooded the outer walls of Zheng and Hua;

sentences.zh: 陳、許、鄜、坊、鄂、曹、濮、襄、魏、博等州大水；

translations.literal: Chen, Xu, Fu, Fang, E, Cao, Pu, Xiang, Wei, and Bo prefectures had great water;
translations.idiomatic: Chen, Xu, Fu, Fang, E, Cao, Pu, Xiang, Wei, and Bo were inundated;

sentences.zh: 江、漢漲溢，壞房、均、荊、襄等州民居及田產殆盡；

translations.literal: the Yangzi and Han rose and overflowed, nearly destroying the dwellings and farmland of Fang, Jun, Jing, Xiang, and other prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: the Yangzi and Han swelled until they nearly destroyed homes and fields across Fang, Jun, Jing, Xiang, and neighboring prefectures;

sentences.zh: 蘇、湖、處等州水溢入城，處州平地八尺。

translations.literal: Su, Hu, and Chu prefectures had water overflow into the cities; at Chu Prefecture on level ground it was eight chi.
translations.idiomatic: floodwaters poured into the cities of Su, Hu, and Chu prefectures; at Chu Prefecture the flats stood eight chi deep.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，西川、滄景、淄青大雨，水，害稼及民廬舍，德州尤甚，平地水深八尺。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year of Kaicheng (839), Xichuan, Cangjing, and Ziqing had great rain and water, damaging crops and people's dwellings and sheds; De Prefecture was especially severe—on level ground the water was eight chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year of Kaicheng (839), torrential rains flooded Xichuan, Cangjing, and Ziqing, ruining crops and private homes; De Prefecture suffered worst of all, with eight chi of water across the flats.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，鎮州及江南水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Kaicheng (840), Zhen Prefecture and Jiangnan had water.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Kaicheng (840), Zhen Prefecture and the Jiangnan region flooded.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年七月，江南大水，漢水壞襄、均等州民居甚眾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Huichang (841), Jiangnan had great water; the Han River destroyed a great many dwellings in Xiang, Jun, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Huichang (841), catastrophic flooding in Jiangnan sent the Han River wrecking countless homes in Xiang, Jun, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中十二年八月，魏、博、幽、鎮、兗、鄆、滑、汴、宋、舒、壽、和、潤等州水，害稼；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year of Dazhong (858), Wei, Bo, You, Zhen, Yan, Yun, Hua, Bian, Song, Shu, Shou, He, and Run prefectures had water, damaging crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year of Dazhong (858), floods struck Wei, Bo, You, Zhen, Yan, Yun, Hua, Bian, Song, Shu, Shou, He, and Run prefectures and damaged the harvest;

sentences.zh: 徐、泗等州水深五丈，漂沒數萬家。

translations.literal: at Xu and Si prefectures the water was five zhang deep, sweeping away tens of thousands of households.
translations.idiomatic: at Xu and Si prefectures the flood stood five zhang deep and swept away tens of thousands of households.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，大水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirteenth year of Dazhong (859), great water.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirteenth year of Dazhong (859), vast floods struck.

sentences.zh: 咸通元年，潁州大水。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiantong (860), Ying Prefecture had great water.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiantong (860), Ying Prefecture was inundated.

sentences.zh: 四年閏六月，東都暴水，自龍門毀定鼎、長夏等門，漂溺居人。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month of the fourth year of Xiantong (863), the Eastern Capital had violent water; from Longmen it destroyed the Dingding, Changxia, and other gates and swept away and drowned residents.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month of the fourth year of Xiantong (863), a flash flood at the Eastern Capital burst in from Longmen, wrecked the Dingding and Changxia gates among others, and swept residents to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 七月，東都、許汝徐泗等州大水，傷稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Eastern Capital and Xu, Ru, Xuzhou, and Si prefectures had great water, injuring crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Eastern Capital and Xu, Ru, Xuzhou, and Si prefectures flooded, damaging the harvest.

sentences.zh: 九月，孝義山水深三丈，破武牢關金城門汜水橋。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, mountain waters at Xiaoyi were three zhang deep, destroying the Jincheng Gate and Sishui Bridge at Wulao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month flash floods at Xiaoyi ran three zhang deep and destroyed the Jincheng Gate and Sishui Bridge at Wulao Pass.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，東都大水，漂壞十二坊，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Xiantong (865), the Eastern Capital had great water, sweeping away twelve wards; those drowned were extremely numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Xiantong (865), great floods at the Eastern Capital washed away twelve wards and drowned a great multitude.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，江淮大水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the seventh year of Xiantong (866), the Jianghuai region had great water.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the seventh year of Xiantong (866), the Jianghuai region suffered catastrophic flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋，河南大水，害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn, Henan had great water, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Henan was inundated and the harvest suffered.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，關東、河南大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, the lands east of the Pass and Henan suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year of Xiantong (873), catastrophic floods struck the lands east of the Pass and Henan.

sentences.zh: 乾符三年，關東大水。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianfu, the lands east of the Pass suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianfu (876), the lands east of the Pass were inundated.

sentences.zh: 光化三年九月，浙江溢，壞民居甚眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Guanghua, Zhejiang overflowed, ruining very many dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year of Guanghua (900), the Zhejiang region flooded and destroyed a great many homes.

sentences.zh: 乾寧三年四月，河圮于滑州，朱全忠決其堤，因為二河，散漫千餘里。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Qianning, the Yellow River collapsed at Huazhou; Zhu Quanzhong breached its dike, and it thus became two rivers, spreading chaotically for more than a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Qianning (896), the Yellow River burst its banks at Huazhou; Zhu Quanzhong deliberately cut the levee, splitting the channel in two, and the waters spread unchecked for more than a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 常寒顯慶四年二月壬子，大雨雪。

translations.literal: Persistent cold. On the day renzi of the second month of the fourth year of Xianqing, great rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent cold. On the day renzi of the second month of the fourth year of Xianqing (659), heavy rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 方春，少陽用事，而寒氣脅之，古占以為人君刑法暴濫之象。

translations.literal: It was spring; lesser yang held dominion, yet cold qi constrained it. Ancient prognostication held this an image of the sovereign's punishments being violent and excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Spring had come, when lesser yang should hold sway, yet cold air pressed upon it. In ancient omen interpretation, this signified a ruler whose criminal law was harsh and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 近常寒也。

translations.literal: This approximates persistent cold.
translations.idiomatic: These are cases approaching persistent cold.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年十月癸酉，大雪，平地三尺，人多凍死。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the tenth month of the first year of Xianheng, great snow; three feet on level ground, and many people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou of the tenth month of the first year of Xianheng (670), heavy snow blanketed the land three feet deep on level ground, and many people perished from the cold.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳三年五月丙寅，高宗在九成宮，霖雨，大寒，兵衞有凍死者。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin of the fifth month of the third year of Yifeng, Emperor Gaozong was at Jiucheng Palace; incessant rain, great cold, and among the military guards some froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin of the fifth month of the third year of Yifeng (678), Emperor Gaozong was at Jiucheng Palace. Relentless rain brought bitter cold, and some of the palace guards froze to death.

sentences.zh: 開耀元年冬，大寒。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Kaiyao, great cold.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Kaiyao (681), the cold was severe.

sentences.zh: 久視元年三月，大雪。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Jushi, great snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Jushi (700), heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年三月乙酉，睦州暴寒且冰。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the third month of the first year of Shenlong, Muzhou suffered sudden cold and ice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou of the third month of the first year of Shenlong (705), Muzhou was struck by sudden cold and ice.

sentences.zh: 開元二十九年九月丁卯，大雨雪，大木偃折。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the ninth month of the twenty-ninth year of Kaiyuan, great rain and snow; large trees toppled and broke.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao of the ninth month of the twenty-ninth year of Kaiyuan (741), torrential snow fell and great trees were uprooted and snapped.

sentences.zh: 大曆四年六月伏日，寒。

translations.literal: On the dog-days of the sixth month of the fourth year of Dali, cold.
translations.idiomatic: On the midsummer dog-days of the sixth month of the fourth year of Dali (769), the weather turned cold.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年正月戊戌，大風雪，寒；

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the first month of the first year of Zhenyuan, great wind and snow, cold;
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu of the first month of the first year of Zhenyuan (785), blizzards brought bitter cold;

sentences.zh: 丙午，又大風雪，寒，民飢，多凍死者。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, again great wind and snow and cold; the people were hungry, and many froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, blizzards returned again. Famine gripped the people, and many froze to death.

sentences.zh: 十二年十二月，大雪甚寒，竹柏柿樹多死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year, great snow and extreme cold; bamboo, cypress, and persimmon trees mostly died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twelfth year of Zhenyuan (796), heavy snow and fierce cold killed most of the bamboo, cypress, and persimmon trees.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有德遭險，厥災暴寒。」

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "When the virtuous meet peril, the calamity is violent cold."
translations.idiomatic: Omen interpretation reads: "When the virtuous meet danger, the calamity manifests as violent cold."

sentences.zh: 十九年三月，大雪。

translations.literal: In the third month of the nineteenth year, great snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the nineteenth year of Zhenyuan (803), heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月庚戌，始雷，大雨雹，震電，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the second month of the twentieth year, thunder first sounded; great hail, lightning, and great rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu of the second month of the twentieth year of Zhenyuan (804), thunder broke for the first time, followed by heavy hail, lightning, and driving snow.

sentences.zh: 既雷則不當雪，陰脅陽也，如魯隱公之九年。

translations.literal: Once thunder has sounded, snow ought not follow; yin constrains yang—like the ninth year of Duke Yin of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Once thunder has rolled, snow should not fall; yin was overpowering yang, as in the ninth year of Duke Yin of Lu.

sentences.zh: 元和六年十二月，大寒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year of Yuanhe, great cold.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixth year of Yuanhe (811), the cold was severe.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，東都大寒，霜厚數寸，雀鼠多死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year, the Eastern Capital suffered great cold; frost several inches thick, and many sparrows and mice died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year of Yuanhe (813), the Eastern Capital was gripped by bitter cold. Frost lay several inches deep, and countless sparrows and mice perished.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月己丑，雨雪，人有凍死者。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the ninth month of the twelfth year, rain and snow; some people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou of the ninth month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe (817), rain and snow fell, and some people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 十五年八月己卯，同州雨雪，害稼。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the eighth month of the fifteenth year, Tongzhou had rain and snow, damaging crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao of the eighth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanhe (820), rain and snow at Tongzhou harmed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年二月，海州海水冰，南北二百里，東望無際。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Changqing, the seawater at Haizhou froze for two hundred li north and south; looking east, there was no visible limit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Changqing (821), the sea off Haizhou froze for two hundred li north and south; gazing eastward, one could see no open water at all.

sentences.zh: 大和六年正月，雨雪踰月，寒甚。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Dahe, rain and snow lasted more than a month; the cold was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year of Dahe (832), rain and snow continued for more than a month, and the cold was fierce.

sentences.zh: 九年十二月，京師苦寒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the ninth year, the capital suffered bitter cold.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the ninth year of Dahe (835), the capital was stricken with bitter cold.

sentences.zh: 會昌三年，春寒，大雪，江左尤甚，民有凍死者。

translations.literal: In the third year of Huichang, spring was cold; great snow, especially severe south of the Yangzi, and some people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Huichang (842), a cold spring brought heavy snow, worst in the lands south of the Yangzi, and some people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 咸通五年冬，隰、石、汾等州大雨雪，平地深五尺。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year of Xiantong, the prefectures of Xi, Shi, Fen, and others had great rain and snow; five feet deep on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year of Xiantong (864), Xi, Shi, Fen, and other prefectures were buried under rain and snow five feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 景福二年二月辛巳，曹州大雪，平地二尺。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the second month of the second year of Jingfu, Caozhou had great snow; two feet on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi of the second month of the second year of Jingfu (893), Caozhou was blanketed in snow two feet deep.

sentences.zh: 天復三年三月，浙西大雪，平地三尺餘，甚氣如煙，其味苦。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Tianfu, western Zhejiang had great snow, more than three feet on level ground; the air was thick like smoke, and bitter in taste.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Tianfu (903), western Zhejiang saw snow more than three feet deep. The air hung like smoke, and the snow tasted bitter.

sentences.zh: 十二月，又大雪，江海冰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, again great snow; the rivers and sea froze.
translations.idiomatic: That twelfth month brought snow again, and the rivers and sea froze over.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年九月壬戌朔，大風，寒如仲冬。

translations.literal: On the first day renxu of the ninth month of the first year of Tianyou, great wind; cold like mid-winter.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renxu of the ninth month of the first year of Tianyou (904), fierce winds brought cold as bitter as mid-winter.

sentences.zh: 是冬，浙東、浙西大雪。

translations.literal: That winter, eastern and western Zhejiang had great snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, eastern and western Zhejiang were buried in heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 吳、越地氣常燠而積雪，近常寒也。

translations.literal: Wu and Yue lands are normally warm in qi, yet snow accumulated—this approximates persistent cold.
translations.idiomatic: Wu and Yue are lands of normally mild climate, yet snow piled deep—another sign approaching persistent cold.

sentences.zh: 鼓妖武德三年二月丁丑，京師西南有聲如崩山。

translations.literal: Drum omens. On the day dingchou of the second month of the third year of Wude, southwest of the capital there was a sound like a mountain collapsing.
translations.idiomatic: Drum omens. On the day dingchou of the second month of the third year of Wude (620), southwest of the capital a sound like a mountain in collapse was heard.

sentences.zh: 近鼓妖也。

translations.literal: This approximates drum omens.
translations.idiomatic: This approximates a drum omen.

sentences.zh: 說者以為人君不聰，為眾所惑，則有聲無形，不知所從生。

translations.literal: Expositors hold that when the ruler is not perceptive and is deluded by the multitude, then there is sound without form, and one does not know whence it arises.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that when a ruler lacks discernment and is led astray by the crowd, sound may appear without visible source, and none can tell where it was born.

sentences.zh: 天授元年九月，檢校內史宗秦客拜日，無雲而雷震。
